title: Drawing Output
description: The engine output (run_calculation): the data the PDF/DXF drawings, reports and saved results are made from.

items.description: bunch of rebar

length.description: length of the piece in meter.

number.description: number of pieces in one bunch.

bend.description: number of pieces with different bend types.

stations.description: the bend length is added to the real stations and reported here.

items.description: start station of the piece.
end station of the piece.

bends.description: the bend lengths of the start and end.

items.description: start bend length.
end bend length.

exteriors.description: each item is an exterior area.

items.description: each item is a point of an exterior area.
the x coordinate of the point.
the y coordinate of the point.

interiors.description: each item is an interior area.

items.description: each item is a point of an interior area.
the x coordinate of the point.
the y coordinate of the point.
each item is a point.
the x coordinate of the point.
the y coordinate of the point.

thickness.description: depth of the area in m.

columns.description: the area of the column bases

items.description: the center point of the column and it's dimensions.

point.description: the center point of the column.

items.description: the x coordinate of the point.
the y coordinate of the point.
the x dim of the column.
the y dim of the column.

fc.description: the strength of the concrete in ton/m^2

fy.description: the yield strength of the steel.

rebars.description: the bend, ovelap and ld  length of the rebars.

items.description: each item contains properties of one rebar size.

length_type.description: number of the length types in a stack or total

pieces.description: this property is for list of pieces.

length.description: length of the piece in meter.

number.description: number of pieces in one bunch.

cut.description: cutting plans of the pieces, one per diameter. empty when cutting is skipped (analysis).

stock_length.description: length of the stock bars in meter.

bars.description: number of stock bars to cut.

waste_ratio.description: waste length over the total stock length.

items.description: a cutting pattern and the number of bars cut with it.

label.description: piece list rows (T, Th, A, S plus row number) of the piece, or w for waste.

summary.description: summery of the rebar and concrete weights.

rebar.description: summery of the weights of the rebars.

concrete.description: total volum of the concrete in cubic meter.

interval.description: distance of two consecutive shear rebar

number.description: number of shear rebars in each section

diameter.description: the diameter of the rebar in mm.

strips.description: the piece arrangement of of each strip

items.description: data of each strip
x coordinate of the point.
y coordinate of the point.

covers.description: top and bottom cover of the strip.

items.description: a row of pieces, each piece a bunch row
a row of pieces, each piece a bunch row

shear_zones.description: all shear zones of the strip with their types

items.description: start station of the period
end station of the period

id.description: shear type id of the zone

ultimate.description: the ultimate momentum that is needed in each station.

resistance.description: the resistance momentum provided by the rebars.

grid.description: x and y axes of the model.

X.description: axes with different x value. the array is ascendingly sorted.

Y.description: axes with different y value. the array is ascendingly sorted.
